arStrings.szText: {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} gains all Skill Upgrades and grants you {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased damage and Damage Reduction for each Skill Rank it has while in {u}{c_important}Arbiter{/c}{/u} form. This bonus doubles for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds after {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} lands.
